message.content:
Greta completed 36 math questions in an hour.
Shirley completed twice as many as Greta, so Shirley completed 36 * 2 = 72 math questions in an hour.
Kiana completed half of the sum of Greta and Shirley's math questions, so Kiana completed (36 + 72) / 2 = 108 / 2 = 54 math questions in an hour.
In one hour, all three girls completed 36 + 72 + 54 = 162 math questions.
Since they did the same number of questions the following hour, in 2 hours they completed 162 * 2 = 324 math questions.

Final answer: 324
